content.label: Examiner note - state changes
content.body: Boiling happens THROUGHOUT a liquid at a fixed temperature; evaporation happens only at the SURFACE, at any temperature. Saying 'the water evaporates at 100 degrees' loses the marking point: it boils at 100 degrees. Write the state-change name the question asks for - 'state' or 'name' wants one word, not a sentence.
